normaliser.rule: case-fold, then strip every non-alphanumeric character
normaliser.match: a plan token names an asset only if its normalised form equals the normalised form of exactly one ledger id
normaliser.warning: Loosening this after seeing results raises V1's pass rate. That is a post-freeze change to section 4 and invalidates the pre-registration (plan.md 12.2).
